blocks.heading: Who sells to you
blocks.text: This page identifies the trader, as required for online sales in the European Union. The contract is formed with the seller named below.

blocks.heading: Complaints
blocks.text: Write to the email address above and describe the order. If we cannot resolve it, you can contact the Hellenic Consumer Ombudsman (www.synigoroskatanaloti.gr) or the consumer authority where you live.

blocks.heading: The contract
blocks.text: A contract is formed when Stripe confirms your payment. Until then you may leave checkout without being charged. The product description, price, and these terms are part of the contract.

blocks.heading: Prices
blocks.text: Shelf prices include VAT. Any shipping charge is shown on the Stripe payment page before you pay. The currency is {{currency}}.

blocks.heading: Law
blocks.text: Greek law applies. If you buy as a consumer in the European Union, you may also bring a claim in the courts of the place where you live. Nothing in these terms limits rights that the law does not allow us to limit.

blocks.heading: Controller
blocks.text: {{company}} is the controller of your personal data for this shop. Contact us at the email address published on the company-details page.

blocks.heading: What we use
blocks.text: We use your name, email, delivery address, phone if you give one, and the contents and status of your order. Card numbers are collected by Stripe and are not stored on this shop. We also keep the invoice data required to issue the legal retail receipt.

blocks.heading: Why
blocks.text: We process this data to perform the sales contract, to meet tax and accounting duties, and to answer a message you send us. The legal bases are the contract, a legal obligation, and, for service messages about your order, our legitimate interest in running the shop.

blocks.heading: Your rights
blocks.text: You may ask for access, correction, erasure, restriction, or a copy of your data, and you may object to processing based on legitimate interest. You may also lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr) or the authority in your country.

blocks.heading: What this shop stores
blocks.text: A locale cookie remembers English or Greek for one year. A session cookie keeps you signed in. The shopping bag and wishlist stay in your browser’s local storage and are not sent to us until you check out.

blocks.heading: Payment
blocks.text: The Stripe payment page sets its own cookies to process the payment and to prevent fraud. Those cookies are used only when you open checkout.

blocks.heading: Choice
blocks.text: The cookies above are required to run the shop, remember your language, and take payment. This shop does not use advertising cookies. You can delete cookies in your browser; the language choice and the signed-in session will then be forgotten.

blocks.heading: Your statutory right
blocks.text: If you buy as a consumer, you may withdraw from the contract within 14 days after you, or someone you appoint, receive the goods. You do not have to give a reason. Tell us by a clear statement to the email on the company-details page. You may use the form below.

blocks.heading: This shop’s return window
blocks.text: We accept a return for 30 days from delivery, which is longer than the 14-day statutory period. The same steps apply.

blocks.heading: Refund
blocks.text: We refund all payments received from you, including standard delivery, within 14 days of your notice. We may wait until we have received the goods back, or until you have shown they were sent. The refund uses the same means of payment, unless you agree otherwise. You pay the direct cost of sending the goods back, unless the goods are faulty or we failed to tell you that you bear that cost.

blocks.heading: When withdrawal does not apply
blocks.text: The right does not apply to goods made to your specification, goods that spoil quickly, or sealed goods that are not suitable for return once the seal is broken for health or hygiene reasons, where the seal was broken after delivery.

blocks.heading: Model form
blocks.text: To {{company}}: I give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the following goods, ordered on [date] and received on [date]. Name, address, and date.

blocks.heading: Before you pay
blocks.text: The order summary on the Stripe page shows the goods, the VAT-inclusive price, and any shipping charge. You can leave that page without paying.

blocks.heading: Delivery
blocks.text: We deliver to the address you enter at checkout. Risk passes to you when you, or a person you appoint, take physical possession of the goods. If a free-shipping offer is running, it is stated in the announcement at the top of the shop.

blocks.heading: Payment
blocks.text: Payment is taken by Stripe in {{currency}}. We do not store your card number. The order is confirmed when the payment succeeds.
